scores.name: Justin Tyme
scores.reason: Admits moving identified poison original to recovery shelf and touching target glass. Misidentification remains possible, but his pair of actions is strongest physical connection.

assessment.why: Justin is the strongest accusation on admitted handling of both original and poisoned target. However no witness identifies his pouring, theft, neck-breaking, fragment wrapping or miniature disposal, so innocent misidentification is a credible rival account.

plausibility_notes: Final testimony resolves many apparent motives through records, but Justin's account alone gives no corroborated resolution. That contrast is an authorial signal, not proof.
The neck fragment's folded favor paper lacks personal attribution in these releases.
